what: Grams CO2e one `remove` avoids per fresh CI install (R), as an SCI delta: the same install with and without the dependency. Downloads, pipelines and install seconds are measured; every coefficient is borrowed. Energy is not measured here.

sources.sci: Green Software Foundation, SCI specification v1.1.0, https://sci.greensoftware.foundation/ (read 2026-10-20)
sources.network_low: Cloud Carbon Footprint methodology, 0.001 kWh/GB, data-centre traffic only, https://www.cloudcarbonfootprint.org/docs/methodology/
sources.network_high: Sustainable Web Design v4: data centres 0.055 + networks 0.059 kWh/GB, which it says will overestimate, https://sustainablewebdesign.org/estimating-digital-emissions/ (read 2026-10-20)
sources.network_disputed: Mytton, Lunden and Malmodin, Journal of Industrial Ecology 28(4), 2024, doi 10.1111/jiec.13512: kWh/GB figures are not accurate enough
sources.runner_power: Cloud Carbon Footprint methodology, GCP per-vCPU and per-GB-memory watts, PUE 1.1
sources.grid: Google Cloud region carbon table, 2025 data, https://cloud.google.com/sustainability/region-carbon
sources.embodied: Cloud Carbon Footprint embodied-emissions method, 4-year life, https://www.cloudcarbonfootprint.org/docs/embodied-emissions/

limits: a delta in a pipeline's SCI, not a full SCI score of the pipeline
a monthly figure multiplies a rate by this project's pipelines; it holds only if each pipeline installs without a cache
it counts only when a reviewer actually replies `remove`
the low and high ends pair low with low and high with high; they are ends of a range, not an average
install seconds are medians of single lines on a shared runner, not the live case's own
the embodied figure reads Cloud Carbon Footprint's unitless file as kg; it is a small share of the live case and most of the low end of the median case, so that end is the least certain
the card flow's model calls are outside this figure: Duo's model energy is not disclosed
